context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features from iteration 5 tested and working: 1) 3D Harry Potter style library at /library with auto-rotation, wooden bookshelves, candlelight effects, and book selection. 2) BookReader has single full-width cover page with play overlay and 'Click to Start Reading'. 3) Fullscreen button expands book with dark background and scale-110. 4) /api/ai/generate-all-images and /api/ai/generate-images-from-text endpoints exist and work. 5) BookEditor has AI Images dropdown with two options. 6) Auto-save in editor with 2-second debounce (silent save, no toast). External URL had intermittent 520 errors during testing but local backend works fine.
